Brevo

Coordinate customer messages around meaningful business events.

BOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Brevo provides customer communication and marketing capabilities with documented APIs for contacts, messaging, and events. MoreSpace can connect approved lifecycle journeys and operational updates with customer records, keeping audience eligibility, message purpose, and delivery feedback visible across the process.

Useful outputs

  • Organized contact segments and reviewed lifecycle message rules
  • Event-driven customer updates and delivery feedback mappings
  • Reporting views linked to customer and lead outcomes

Where we can apply it

  • Subscribed enquiry → contact segment → welcome journey → qualified follow-up.
  • Approved business event → recipient check → transactional message → delivery feedback.
  • Contact preference change → authorized sync → suppression rule → eligible audience update.
01

Use case 1

Build subscribed audience segments and reviewed lifecycle campaigns.

02

Use case 2

Trigger approved transactional or customer updates from eligible business events.

03

Use case 3

Connect contact changes and delivery feedback with a shared customer workspace.

Inputs we need

  • Authorized contact data and communication preference records
  • Approved message templates, business events, and channel purposes
  • Sending domain setup, recipient rules, and escalation ownership

Delivery sequence

  • Define the audiences, message purposes, and eligible triggering events.
  • Configure authorized contacts and messaging, then test suppression and webhook behavior.
  • Activate reviewed journeys and monitor delivery quality and customer outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve audience eligibility, message frequency, and sender identity before sending.
  • Review bounced, opted-out, and ambiguous event records before further contact.
